Summary.en: This Element Placeholder registers the "Date.Holidays"-EP that makes requests to "API-Feiertage.de" in order to retrieve german holidays of all states.
Summary.de: Dieser Element-Placeholder liefert die gesetzlichen Feiertage für ein Bundesland und Jahr.

params.description: A state abbreviation (bw, by, be, bb, hb, hh, he, mv, ni, nw, rp, sl, sn, st, sh, th) or "THIS_YEAR" for the current year.
A state abbreviation, a year, "THIS_YEAR" (optionally with +/- arithmetic like "THIS_YEAR + 1"), "Friedensfest" or "KATHOLISCH".
and beyond: More states, years, "THIS_YEAR", "Friedensfest" or "KATHOLISCH" in any order.
